name: tree-sitter-sail
description: Tree-sitter grammar for the SAIL .sail template language

scripts.test: tree-sitter test && cargo test -p tree-sitter-sail --test injections --test block_vocabulary
scripts.generate: (cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p sail-compiler -- vocabulary --out /tmp/sail-grammar-vocab.json) && bun run scripts/generate-grammar.ts --vocab /tmp/sail-grammar-vocab.json --out-dir .
